args.sql:
WITH qualifying_robots AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.effectivenessrobot AS robot_id, 
        ps.conditionindexval AS jdi, 
        op.totopshrval AS toh
    FROM 
        performance_and_safety ps
    JOIN 
        operation op ON ps.effectivenessoperation = op.operreg
    WHERE 
        ps.conditionindexval > 1.5 
        AND op.totopshrval > 5000
),
regression_slopes AS (
    SELECT 
        qr.robot_id, 
        SUM(qr.jdi * qr.toh) AS sum_xy, 
        SUM(qr.jdi) AS sum_y, 
        SUM(qr.toh) AS sum_x, 
        SUM(qr.toh * qr.toh) AS sum_x_squared, 
        COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM 
        qualifying_robots qr
    GROUP BY 
        qr.robot_id
),
robot_details AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, 
        rd.mfgnameval AS manufacturer, 
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series, 
        rd.bottypeval AS robot_type, 
        rd.payloadcapkg AS payload_capacity, 
        rd.reachmmval AS reach_mm, 
        rd.instdateval AS installation_date, 
        rd.fwversionval AS firmware_version, 
        rd.ctrltypeval AS controller_type
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
)
SELECT 
    rd.robot_id, 
    rd.manufacturer, 
    rd.model_series, 
    rd.robot_type, 
    rd.payload_capacity, 
    rd.reach_mm, 
    rd.installation_date, 
    rd.firmware_version, 
    rd.controller_type, 
    (rs.n * rs.sum_xy - rs.sum_x * rs.sum_y) / (rs.n * rs.sum_x_squared - rs.sum_x * rs.sum_x) AS jdi_toh_slope
FROM 
    regression_slopes rs
JOIN 
    robot_details rd ON rs.robot_id = rd.robot_id
ORDER BY 
    rd.robot_id
LIMIT 10;
